# Digital Macaroni

> Digital Macaroni designs and builds custom AI voice agents for businesses: phone agents that answer calls, talk like a person, and handle the work that comes with the call. It also builds the dashboards and apps around them.

Official website: https://digitalmacaroni.io
Studio enquiries: hello@digitalmacaroni.io
Founder: Leif Johansen (https://www.linkedin.com/in/iamleifjohansen/)
About: https://digitalmacaroni.io/about/
Based in: Oslo, Norway
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/digitalmacaroni/
Updated: 2026-10-04

## Services

- Custom AI phone agents designed around business information, rules, and permitted actions.
- Dashboards and business software for conversations, tasks, scheduling, and operations.
- Custom web and mobile apps, from early prototypes to working applications.

Ready-made agents start at $2,500 USD; custom agents from $5,000 USD. Running options: self-hosted (no monthly fee from us; $500 one-time setup), hosted from $149/month, managed from $399/month. Scope, integrations and price are agreed in a proposal for each project.

## Owned products

- [RankLadder](https://rankladder.app): Customer conversations and front-office tools for local businesses.
- [Hey Anders](https://heyanders.com): An AI assistant and workspace for appointment-based practices.
- [TwoTop](https://twotop.app): Hospitality scheduling, communication, and team operations.

Use each product's official website for current features, pricing, availability, and terms. These are studio products, not client endorsements.

## Voice demos

- [Northline](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/northline/): fictional home-services business; the agent books, moves, and cancels service visits.
- [Form & Field](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/formfield/): fictional shop; the agent finds products, checks stock, holds items for pickup, and looks up orders.
- [Waypoint Travel](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/travel/): fictional travel agency; the agent searches test-environment airline fares and stops before payment.

All demo data is fictional. Demo actions do not dispatch technicians, fulfil orders, issue tickets, or take payments.
